## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
raw_mlb_data <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paynemasaitis/jour-405/refs/heads/main/Teams.csv")
```
```{r}
teams_5yr <- raw_mlb_data %>%
  filter(yearID >= 2021 & yearID <= 2025) %>%
  select(name, yearID, SO, W, L, G)
```

## Data Description

After filtering through the raw team data (courtesy of the Lahman Baseball Database), I picked out the offensive strikeout numbers from all MLB teams across the last five seasons. With further data analysis (and potentially an extension of the time period), I will determine the strikeout rates and how they correlate to winning and losing baseball games. If more data is needed, the entire raw MLB data file is also in here, which makes that a lot more accessible if more data is needed to make a conclusion about the hypothesis.


## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
